thread: lucy: quick pass on a11y after yesterday's layout polish — grouping a couple items so we can batch fixes :memo: lucy: 1) the vertical resizer handle between left nav and main content is clickable but not keyboard operable. no role or aria attributes, and SR users don't get position feedback lucy: 2) stacked toasts announce only the newest; when multiple toasts appear SR users lose context about earlier failures lucy: 3) status gradient in model list uses color stops to convey "degraded -> healthy" but there's no text or accessible name for it lucy: 4) keyboard shortcut helper (press ? to open) is documented but the helper modal isn't reachable by keyboard when opened via shortcut (focus lands outside) omar: thanks — sounds actionable. resizer: add `role=\"separator\" aria-orientation=\"vertical\" tabindex=0 aria-valuemin=\"200\" aria-valuemax=\"1200\" aria-valuenow=\"400\"` and nudge handlers on Arrow keys. also update the live region when it changes like "Left pane width 400 pixels" so SR users know position anya: toasts: instead of hiding older toasts with `aria-hidden`, keep them visible and use a small polite live queue that announces each new summary like "Build failed: OOM" and then "Retry succeeded". for bursts aggregate with "3 notifications" after 2s if more arrive. avoid verbosity omar: gradient: expose a concise stat inline: e.g., `Health: degraded (45%)` or `role=\"img\" aria-label=\"Health: 45 percent, degraded\"`. prefer the aria-label on the gradient element so we don't duplicate visible text lucy: shortcut helper: when ? opens the Help modal via JS we need to `focus()` the first focusable in the modal and trap focus. also ensure the shortcut doesn't bypass focus management. add `aria-modal=\"true\" aria-labelledby` on the modal a11y-bot: automated scan (layout-polish/2026-05-01) detected 6 issues: 2 high (resizer not keyboard accessible; shortcut modal focus not restored), 1 medium (gradient lacks accessible name). Report: https://ci.redwood/axe/scan/4122 :warning: omar: prioritization: 1) resizer keyboard + aria-valuenow updates 2) shortcut modal focus trap + restore 3) toast announcer batching 4) gradient aria-name anya: owners: omar takes resizer + gradient aria-label; lucy takes toasts + shortcut modal focus + tests. i'll add acceptance criteria: resizer tabbable and Arrow keys adjust width; SR announces width; pressing ? opens help modal and SR reads title; new toasts read short summaries and aggregates on bursts. QA should run NVDA/VO and include a short screen recording qa-bot: suggested e2e cases: tab to resizer and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight nudge; trigger ? and assert focus inside modal; simulate 5 rapid toasts and assert aggregator message appears in live region lucy: i'll open PRs as drafts and tag `@eng-accessibility` and `@qa`. will include the a11y-bot scan link and a small code snippet for the resizer handler omar: snippet for Arrow handlers (will include in PR): ``` // on keydown if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') setWidth(w => Math.max(min, w - 8)) if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') setWidth(w => Math.min(max, w + 8)) liveRegion.textContent = `Left pane width ${width} pixels`; ``` lucy: perfect. thanks team — aiming for next sprint's first patch. closing thread after PRs are up :rocket:
